subject: Late-stage slot reservation ops plan — Crowbridge AI
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 5 Jun 2029 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Late-stage slot reservation ops plan — Crowbridge AI

Hi team,

Crowbridge (attached MOP) moved this to committed-prep after last week's exec call. They expect a soft go-live target in mid-July and want us to guarantee runway for the first 90 days. High-level ask from Sales/Product: 12 A100-40GB-equivalent nodes for training/ingest and 8 H100-equivalent nodes for inference burst capacity, spread across two availability zones in us-west.

Questions I need answers to by EOD tomorrow so we can give the customer a date & partial hold window:
- Can Ops map 12 A100-40GB + 8 H100 slots to specific node IDs and regions for the July window?
- What are the realistic soft-hold durations we can offer (14/30 days) without impacting current commitments?
- Any implications for mixed-tenant scheduling or preemption risk if we reserve these for Crowbridge?

I'll loop Legal/Procurement once we have inventory confirmation. Attaching the Crowbridge MOP they sent (they included an updated traffic profile and go-live milestones).

Next steps: Ben — can you run a quick inventory + contention check and suggest a recommended hold length? Neha — flag any SLA implications if we allocate H100s for burst. Marissa/Dev — if we need to carve a dedicated slice in Dedicated, note the minimal config (CUDA version, kernel constraints, network egress limits).

Thanks,
Karthik
VP Sales, Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 5 Jun 2029 10:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Late-stage slot reservation ops plan — Crowbridge AI

Karthik — quick inventory snapshot below after talking to fleet scheduling and the regional pod leads. See attached CSV for node IDs and maintenance windows.

Inventory summary (us-west):
- A100-40GB equivalents: 18 available in AZ-a / 9 available in AZ-b (total 27).
- H100-equivalents: 10 available in AZ-a / 6 available in AZ-b (total 16).

Recommendation: place a 14-day provisional soft hold on the following (we can escalate to 30d with a corresponding spend commitment):
- 12x A100-40GB (prefer AZ-a for locality) -> nodes: aws-usw-a-n[1203..1214] (see CSV)
- 8x H100 (spread AZ-a/b) -> nodes: aws-usw-h[450..457]

Operational notes / risk:
- Soft hold is implemented as a scheduler reservation with preemption priority lowered for non-reserved workloads; it does not require immediate re-provisioning but flags those nodes for Crowbridge traffic.
- Maintenance windows: AZ-a has a quarterly kernel update scheduled 2029-06-20 — we can rescope it to exclude reserved nodes if Legal signs off on a 30-day hold.
- Cost impact: Reserving without a signed commit increases opportunity cost; recommend a conditional credit or short-term commitment to offset idle capacity if they want >14 days.

Attached: node-availability-20290605.csv (node_id,az,type,maintenance).

If Sales agrees, I'll open CAP-TICKET-7419 to apply the soft hold and mark nodes with reservation tag "CB-2029-0587-softhold". Also propose we set an automatic expiry (14 days) and a manual review flag at day 10.

—Ben
Senior Capacity Manager, Redwood Inference
From: Samira Patel <samira@crowbridge.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ethan Lowe <ethan.lowe@crowbridge.ai>, Crowbridge Procurement <procurement@crowbridge.ai>
Date: Wed, 5 Jun 2029 13:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Late-stage slot reservation ops plan — Crowbridge AI

Karthik — thanks for the quick loop. We reviewed the proposed inventory and it's in line with our staging plan. Two asks from our side before we signal internal go/no-go to execs:

1) Can Redwood provisionally hold the 12 A100 + 8 H100 set for a 21-day window while we finalize the PO and staffing ramp? We can commit to a 60-day provisional MSA that includes a ramp schedule and a capped committed spend for month one.

2) Can you provide a notional monthly cost estimate for the reserved slice (both soft-hold and committed pricing) so we can run the procurement calc?

If possible, please queue a short 30-minute call tomorrow AM to iron out hold length and DocuSign milestones. We're prepared to share a redline for the provisional MSA during that call.

Thanks — Samira
Head of Platform, Crowbridge AI

Subject: Re: Late-stage slot reservation ops plan — Crowbridge AI

Samira — thanks. Ben's inventory confirms we can place a provisional soft hold. We'll do the following now:

1) Ops: Ben, please create CAP-TICKET-7419 and tag nodes with "CB-2029-0587-softhold" with a default expiry of 21 days (2029-06-27) and a manual review at day 14. Please exclude reserved nodes from the 2029-06-20 kernel maintenance.
2) Legal/Procurement: I'll share a one-page provisional MSA (60-day trial + conditional credit for idle capacity). Marissa / Dev, please coordinate the DocuSign link and a short template for a provisional purchase order; link HubSpot deal CB-2029-0587.
3) Sales: Samira, we'll send a notional cost estimate for both a 14-day trial hold and a 60-day committed price by EOD tomorrow.

Ben — once the ticket is open, drop the CAP-TICKET number and the explicit node IDs in this thread, and I'll forward to Crowbridge procurement so their team can align internal approvals.

Karthik
VP Sales, Redwood Inference

Karthik Iyer
